scope: Original PSD death recap over native accepted HP loss and native restart actions

behavior.entrypoint: Automatic on the local player death event or complete authenticated native death page; replaces restartdialog using its normal GameUi lifecycle
behavior.history: Only actual accepted negative HP deltas are recorded after native clamping. Rolling ten-second monotonic journal, at most 256 hits, overflow explicitly indicated. Player, NPC and unknown-source metadata copied at the hit, critical outcome, skill ID and periodic poison/fire context retained
behavior.window: Original two-panel artwork and title, right dock, proportional compact sizing, readable desktop/touch type and minimum action hit areas. Scrollable timeline and source list; health trace; full numbers/source in tooltips; damage share and advice derived from actual received metrics
behavior.names: Localized player skill names when the existing native skill ID and client skill catalog identify one; generic attack/ability/effect captions otherwise, without invented boss ability names
behavior.restart: Here/town buttons send the existing /restart_here and /restart_town native commands. The UI never changes HP, position, currency or items. Current native death penalty and dungeon-specific restart rules remain authoritative; the UI closes only on server confirmation
behavior.dismissal: Escape/dismiss cannot remove restart choices while dead; server revival/logout clears the personal view and restores normal window behavior
behavior.sample_text: Removed the demonstration one-scroll cost, automatic-town countdown, armor durability and auto-potion claims. The existing native server uses manual restart; no new automatic resurrection policy or item cost was introduced

security.ownership: Server snapshots are indexed by the authenticated player PID only; /death_ui accepts no target PID or supplied damage. No history broadcast to other players
security.protocol: Versioned nx_death_* native command messages; owner identity, complete atomic pages, declared counts, exact HP deltas, bounded names/hit count/timestamps, 64-bit values and malformed page rejection validated by Unity
security.identity: Random nonzero 64-bit server death IDs; client tracks recent accepted IDs to reject replay without assuming ordering across different cores
security.storage: Bounded in-memory journal and at most 1024 recent participant snapshots per core, ten-minute expiry. No new database schema or durable death archive; server restart discards this temporary data
